body: [{"streamId":"01a0baa9-5718-714f-880d-d28ca56cf16e","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a0baa9-5718-714f-880d-d28ca56cf16e\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022An explicit stream request (EventCatchUpRequest.ForStreamId set, from a vouched member) is answered with the stream\\u0027s whole history even when its events sit at or below the answering node\\u0027s switch-on sequence, private tasks and ideas excepted; ordinary flushes and gap-fills keep the switch-on exclusion\u0022,\u0022h9k task pull \\u003Cid\\u003E (working name; match the noun-first CLI conventions) on a node that lacks that task\\u0027s stream queues the same broadcast events-request that h9k task add --from-issue already queues for a task published elsewhere (EventCatchUpCoordinator.RequestStreamBroadcastAsync), refuses with a sentence naming h9k project join when this node has no owner root yet, and prints where the request stands; h9k status shows the outstanding request the way it shows the others\u0022,\u0022The --from-issue refusal for a task published elsewhere says whether a request was queued or not: when the node has no owner root, it says catch-up cannot bring the stream until h9k project join has run, instead of promising it will appear\u0022,\u0022h9k project pull \\u003Cproject\\u003E --since \\u003Cglobal-sequence|all\\u003E queues a history request for an established node that never bootstraps (MessageSweepEngine.HasAnyLocalHistoryAsync gates the bootstrap to brand-new nodes), answered under the same explicit-request rule and applied idempotently over streams the node already holds; docs (concepts.md, cli.md) say which node states bootstrap, which gap-fill, which pull\u0022,\u0022Unit tests cover: a ForStreamId request served below the switch-on sequence and a private task still refused; an ordinary flush still excluded below it; the pull queues one broadcast request and a second call reports it outstanding; both refusal texts; a project pull applied over held streams; no test creates branches or touches GitHub\u0022,\u0022dotnet build and dotnet test pass; the decision log carries one entry under this task\\u0027s placeholder\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022Cut 2026-09-19 13:2x EDT on Brian\\u0027s word after the first two-node connection (Mac genesis, Windows joined by invite 12:51 EDT on v0.10.0), narrowed at 13:3x, widened at 13:5x with the verified root cause. Evidence: live replication works (the Mac\\u0027s refs/hall9k/messages/\\u003Cnode\\u003E outbox carries kind=events envelopes; the Mac holds an EventReplicationInboxCursor for Windows). Windows\\u0027s re-run of h9k task add --project hall9k --from-issue 447 at 13:40 queued the broadcast events-request (Windows outbox messages/2.json, forStreamId 01a0afc1-fc97-73b5-836e-39b8ec35ceca) and the Mac answered events-unavailable \\u0027nothing held here matches this request\\u0027 (Mac outbox messages/14.json, 13:41). Root cause, verified in code and store: EventCatchUpResponder skips every candidate with candidate.Sequence \\u003C= switchOnSequence (EventReplicationOutbox.EnsureSwitchedOnAsync; the Mac\\u0027s ReplicationSwitchedOn at 16:46:12Z has switchOnGlobalSequence 30084) while ec35ceca\\u0027s nine events sit at seq 28273 to 30020, with origin headers present (nodeId, ownerRootFingerprint). So any task published on a node before that node switched replication on can never be served to a peer, and the from-issue refusal keeps promising it will arrive. Related: MessageSweepEngine.HasAnyLocalHistoryAsync gates the bootstrap to brand-new nodes. Lineage: a gap in M2b (idea 202383dc), not a fix of a fix. Boundaries: keep the switch-on exclusion for ordinary flushes and gap-fills (history is inert until asked for); an explicit stream request is the opt-in; never serve a private task or idea; reuse EventCatchUpCoordinator and the responder. Placement: Mac; a chasing fix for the distributed-team release, candidate for v0.10.1.\u0022},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-09-19T17:50:42.605572\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"45f4f387-bafa-48af-a8de-970cd966e534","originSequence":30180,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-09-19T17:50:42.619095+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"}]
